seoTitle: Once Upon a Time Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Once Upon a Time test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Emma, Snow White, Prince Charming, Regina, Rumplestiltskin, Belle, Hook or Zelena — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the saviour, the queen, or the one making deals? Answer 11 everyday questions about trust, family and second chances, and find out which Once Upon a Time character you are.

characters.name: Emma Swan
characters.title: The Reluctant Saviour
characters.summary: Tough, independent and slow to trust. You've looked after yourself for so long that letting people in is the hard part.
description: Like Emma, you're used to doing things on your own. She grew up in foster care and was working as a bail bonds agent in Boston when her story begins.
You can tell when someone's lying to you. Emma calls it her superpower, and it's how she survived on her own for so long.
You come round, eventually. Emma didn't believe a word of it when Henry turned up on her doorstep, but she became the Saviour, the sheriff of Storybrooke, and Hook's wife.
characters.flaw: You leave before anyone gets the chance to leave you.
characters.signature: A red leather jacket, a yellow Bug and a very good nose for lies.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep you at arm's length until you'd proved yourself

characters.name: Snow White
characters.title: The Eternal Optimist
characters.summary: Hopeful, kind and forgiving. You believe in people, even the ones who've given you every reason not to.
description: Like Snow, you never give up hope. She's known for her speeches about hope, even when things look hopeless.
You forgive people who don't deserve it. Snow spends years trying to make peace with Regina, the stepmother who wanted her dead.
You're tougher than you look. Snow lived as a bandit in the forest, and in Storybrooke she's Mary Margaret, the kind schoolteacher.
characters.flaw: You carry guilt for years over things other people forgot about long ago.
characters.signature: A bow and arrow, a classroom full of kids and a speech about hope.
characters.clashReason: they'd forgive the person you're still angry with, and expect you to as well

characters.name: Prince Charming
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Brave, loyal and first through the door. When someone you love is in trouble, you don't stop to think.
description: Like David, you're not who people expect. Prince Charming was really a shepherd, who took his twin brother's place as a prince.
You'll always find your people. 'I will always find you' is his and Snow's promise to each other, and they keep it.
Protecting people is just what you do. In Storybrooke, David even serves as the town's sheriff, and he's first in line whenever the town needs a hero.
characters.flaw: You charge in first and ask what the plan was afterwards.
characters.signature: A sword, a sensible plan B nobody asked for and a promise you always keep.
characters.clashReason: they'd rush in to save you when you had it handled

characters.name: Regina Mills
characters.title: The Queen
characters.summary: Proud, sharp and always in control. You hold a grudge beautifully, but you'd do anything for the people you love.
description: Like Regina, you like things done your way. As the Evil Queen she cast the Dark Curse, and in Storybrooke she runs the whole town as mayor.
You don't forget. Regina's war with Snow began when young Snow told Regina's mother about Daniel, the stable boy Regina loved, and her mother killed him.
You can change. Regina's love for her adopted son, Henry, pushes her from villain to hero, and she ends the show as the Good Queen.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be feared than admit you were hurt.
characters.signature: A prize apple tree, a basket of Honeycrisps for the new neighbour and a withering look.
characters.clashReason: they'd remember exactly what you did, and bring it up years later

characters.name: Rumplestiltskin
characters.title: The Dealmaker
characters.summary: Clever, patient and always three moves ahead. You know everything has a price, and you always get yours.
description: Like Rumplestiltskin, you can see the angle in any situation. All magic comes with a price, he says, and he's usually the one collecting.
You'll do anything for the people you love, even the wrong thing. He became the Dark One to protect his son, Baelfire.
You have a soft spot you'd never admit to. As Mr. Gold, he runs Storybrooke's pawnshop, and he keeps Belle's chipped cup for decades.
characters.flaw: You promise to change, then keep one little secret just in case.
characters.signature: A shop full of strange antiques, a deal with very small print and a 'dearie'.
characters.clashReason: they'd help you out, then name their price

characters.name: Belle
characters.title: The Bookworm
characters.summary: Curious, idealistic and braver than you look. You see the good in people, even when nobody else does.
description: Like Belle, you'd be happy in a library forever. In Storybrooke, she reopens the town library and becomes its librarian.
You're braver than people think. Belle made a deal to go and live with Rumplestiltskin, so that he would protect her town from an ogre attack.
You see the good in people. Belle loved Rumplestiltskin when everyone else saw a monster, and she married him.
characters.flaw: You keep believing someone will change long after they've shown you they won't.
characters.signature: A stack of library books, a chipped teacup and a lot of faith in people.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep seeing the good in someone you know is trouble

characters.name: Captain Hook
characters.title: The Charming Rogue
characters.summary: Flirty, sarcastic and up for anything. You hide a big heart behind a lot of charm.
description: Like Killian Jones, you know how to make an entrance. He's the captain of the Jolly Roger, with a hook where his left hand used to be.
You can hold a grudge for a very long time. Rumplestiltskin cut off his hand and killed Milah, the woman he loved, and Hook spent centuries trying to get revenge.
Once you're in, you're all in. Hook slowly goes from villain to hero because of Emma, and they get married in the show's musical episode.
characters.flaw: You joke your way out of every serious conversation.
characters.signature: A leather coat, a flask of rum and a line ready for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd flirt with everyone at the table and call it being friendly

characters.name: Zelena
characters.title: The Wicked Sister
characters.summary: Dramatic, funny and a little bit jealous. You just want someone to pick you first for once.
description: Like Zelena, you know what it's like to feel second best. Her mother, Cora, gave her up as a baby, and she grew up in Oz.
You can get a bit green with envy. When Zelena found out about her half-sister, Regina, she was so jealous that her skin literally turned green.
You can turn it around. Zelena becomes the Wicked Witch of the West, but in the end she makes peace with Regina and raises her daughter, Robin.
characters.flaw: You compare yourself with everyone, and you always come off worse in your own head.
characters.signature: A broomstick, a big entrance and a long list of people who underestimated you.
characters.clashReason: they'd feel like you were the favourite, and never let it go

questions.text: A friend hasn't answered your messages for three days. You...

options.text: Assume they're done with you. People usually leave eventually
Send a warm message saying you're there whenever they're ready
Go round to their place and check they're okay
Assume they've found a new best friend, and check who they've been out with
Curled up in a quiet corner with a book you can't put down
Out on the water with the wind in your face
Digging through a flea market for things worth more than the seller knows
Fixing something around the house, then a long walk

questions.text: Someone offers to help you out, as long as you owe them a favour later. They'll decide what. You...

options.text: Say no thanks. You'd rather not owe anyone
Agree. They seem decent, and they'll probably be fair
Agree, but only once you've set the terms yourself
Shake on it with a grin. You'll deal with later when later comes

questions.text: Your boss praises a colleague in front of everyone, for work you did just as well. You...

options.text: Clap the loudest, then spend all evening comparing yourself to them
Congratulate them, and actually mean it
Say nothing, and make sure next time your work can't be ignored
Shrug. You do the work because it needs doing, not for the praise

questions.text: You see a stranger with a broken-down car at the side of the road, in the rain. You...

options.text: Pull over and change the tyre for them
Keep driving. Someone else will stop
Stop, but stay in the car and ask a few questions first
Offer them a lift, and keep them laughing the whole way

questions.text: You've made a big mistake that hurt someone. You...

options.text: Apologise, then spend as long as it takes proving you've changed
Explain why it wasn't really your fault
Feel terrible about it for weeks, long after they've forgiven you
Fix what you can on your own, quietly, and hope nobody makes it a big conversation

questions.text: Your partner asks you to give up a risky hobby you love, because it worries them. You...

options.text: Promise you'll stop, then keep doing it quietly
Tell them you'll be careful, and mean it. Mostly
Tell them you hear them, but it's your life and your call
Give it up. They matter more than any hobby

questions.text: An old friend who dropped you years ago wants to meet up and make amends. You...

options.text: Go. People can change, and they deserve the chance to show you
Don't reply. They made their choice a long time ago
Meet them. You'll know within five minutes whether they mean it
Go, and make sure they see how well you're doing without them

questions.text: Your dream job comes up, but you'd have to move far away from everyone you love. You...

options.text: Take it, and tell yourself they'll understand
Turn it down. Home is wherever your people are
Take it. You've always wanted to see more of the world
Push the company until they let you do it from home

questions.text: You're living in a fairy-tale kingdom. The person who ruined your family is finally at your mercy. You...

options.text: Take your revenge. You've waited long enough for this
Let them go. Revenge would only make you as bad as them
Wait. There's a cleverer way to do this, and you've got time
Take away everything they love, so they know how it feels

questions.text: You live in a small town under a curse, and nobody remembers who they really are. Only you know the truth. You...

options.text: Keep believing in everyone until they start believing too
Leave it. Maybe everyone's happier not knowing
Find a way to break it yourself, whatever it takes
Keep it to yourself until you can prove it. Nobody would believe you
